klfritzwalterstadion.name: Fritz-Walter-Stadion
klfritzwalterstadion.slogan: The Betze: a whole city roars from one hilltop.
klfritzwalterstadion.line: Named for Fritz Walter, who captained West Germany to the 1954 World Cup; the hill gave the stadium its nickname, the Betze.

klberwartstein.name: Burg Berwartstein
klberwartstein.slogan: Stairs, halls and a well all carved straight into the sandstone.
klberwartstein.line: Its well was cut about 104 metres into the rock, and the castle was probably never taken in the Middle Ages.

klnanstein.name: Burg Nanstein
klnanstein.slogan: The ruin where a rebel knight made his last stand above Landstuhl.
klnanstein.line: In 1523 Franz von Sickingen was mortally wounded here while besieged by three princes' armies.

klstiftskirche.name: Stiftskirche
klstiftskirche.slogan: Kaiserslautern's oldest church, still the calm heart of the city.
klstiftskirche.line: The Stiftskirche was built between 1250 and 1350 and is the city's oldest church.

klteufelstisch.name: Teufelstisch
klteufelstisch.slogan: A stone mushroom balanced on a pillar in the Palatinate Forest.
klteufelstisch.line: This 14-metre mushroom rock is sandstone laid down about 250 million years ago.
